## Think in systems

Study how vehicle subsystems receive inputs, perform functions, and interact with other systems.

## Connect mechanical and electrical ideas

Use diagrams, measurements, demonstrations, and simple logic examples to understand systems such as starting, charging, cooling, braking, and warning circuits.

## Document what you observe

Use labelled photographs, measured values, diagrams, and short explanations to make hands-on observations useful later.
